description:
SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT

Navy Supply Command Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound (NAVSUP FLCPS) is posting a Sources Sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify any interested vendors for the procurement of OEM A-Pak Solutions for the procurement of Manhole, Access & Flood Alarm System parts, in support of SRF-JRMC.

The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 335313, with a small business size standard of 1,250 employees.

The results of this market research may contribute to future procurement process decisions. NO feedback or evaluations will be provided regarding any submission to this Sources Sought notice. Please provide responses to this announcement no later than the posted closing date.

DESCRIPTION OF REQUESTED SUPPLIES:

OEM A-Pak Solutions - Manhole, Access, Flood Alarm System Parts

1) CAB B4 W/ SEISKIT MOUNTING KIT
NOTIFIER OR EQUAL

2) FIRE ALARM PANEL
NOTIFIER NFS-320 OR EQUAL

NOTIFIER FSP-951 OR EQUAL

NOTIFIER B300-6

All responses to this Sources Sought notice should be emailed to Walid Aslan (walid.m.aslan.civ@us.navy.mil) and include the following information:

Your organization name, physical address, CAGE code, email address, website, telephone number, classification (Small Business/Other Than Small) status under NAICS code 335313.

**THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTE** - submission of any information in response to this Sources Sought notice is purely voluntary and the Government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. The results of this market research may contribute to future procurement process decisions. No feedback or evaluations will be provided to responses against this Sources Sought notice.
